Problem: Two bottles of different ideal gases, same temperature and pressure, different volumes. What relations: number density n (molecules per unit volume), total translational kinetic energy per unit volume (E_K/V), mass density rho. Options:
A n different, E_K/V different, rho different
B n different, E_K/V different, rho same
C n same, E_K/V same, rho different
D n same, E_K/V same, rho same

We need select. Ideal gas: p = n k T (number density n). Same T, p => n same. Total translational kinetic energy per molecule = (3/2) k T for ideal gas (monatomic? But translational only for any gas molecules? Yes total translational kinetic energy per molecule average = 3/2 kT). Then total translational kinetic energy per unit volume = n * 3/2 kT = (3/2) p. Same p => same. Or E_K/V = 3/2 p? Actually total translational KE per volume = n * 3/2 kT = 3/2 p. Same p, same. rho = mass per volume = n * molecular mass m0. Different gases have different molecular masses, n same => rho different (unless coincidentally same molecular mass, but different种类 typically different molar mass; question asks relation generally? Options C says rho different. Yes). So answer C.

Need final line "答案：C". Need likely include explanation? User asks select correct. Desired final format. Can provide concise reasoning in Chinese then final line. Ensure last line exact.

Double-check: Could volume different matter? No. unit volume quantities independent of total volume. If same T,p, n same by ideal gas law. E_K/V: total translational kinetic energy of molecules per volume. For ideal gas, average translational KE = 3/2 kT regardless of gas. Same T => same per molecule; n same => same per volume. rho = mass density = p M/(R T), M different => different. If gas types different but maybe molar mass could same? Different kind implies not same molecular mass generally; exam expects different. So C.

content:
由理想气体状态方程 \(p = nkT\) 可知，温度和压强相同时，单位体积内的气体分子数 \(n\) 相同。

单位体积内气体分子的总平动动能为  
\[
\frac{E_K}{V} = n \cdot \frac{3}{2}kT = \frac{3}{2}p
\]
压强相同，因此 \(\frac{E_K}{V}\) 也相同。

单位体积内的气体质量即密度：
\[
\rho = nm_0
\]
不同种类理想气体的分子质量 \(m_0\) 不同，因此 \(\rho\) 不同。

答案：C
